title: No Travel Incomplete, Safety (arrival delay code 46, aircraft change for technical reasons), delay 6�9h, APPR, Basic Aeroplan
description:
Two-leg journey. Leg 1 operated on time. Leg 2 was delayed 7h 10m (inside the 6 to 9 hour band) by arrival delay code 46. The aircraft scheduled for AC 477 had a technical fault, and a replacement aircraft had to be swapped in before the flight could depart safely (Safety). The customer was stranded at the connection (YYZ). They didn't continue, didn't return to YUL and didn't reach YVR. Checks four things: (1) the MSL is Leg 2, (2) code 46 on the connecting leg is classed as Safety, (3) No Travel Incomplete is detected, and (4) the 6 to 9 hour delay and Aeroplan Basic tier don't change the NE-18 result.

Prerequisites:
PNR TC070: one adult passenger, Jacques Fortier. Two AC domestic legs, YUL?YYZ?YVR, June 1, 2026. Leg 1 AC 476 YUL?YYZ: operated on time, no delay codes. Leg 2 AC 477 YYZ?YVR: scheduled 12:00 ? 14:05 (local). Actual departure 19:10 (430 min late). Actual arrival 21:15 (430 min late). Status: DELAYED (operated). Cancellation code: NONE. First arrival delay code 46 (TC). First departure delay code 46 (TC). No other delay codes on the MSL. Customer stranded at YYZ, didn't board Leg 2, Leg 2 coupon not flown. No Travel status: Incomplete. No rebooking accepted. Aeroplan: linked, tier code A (Aeroplan Basic). No expense receipts. Fallback: FALSE. Regime: APPR. More than 72 hours have passed. Filed within 366 days.
